'''Kooriva''' was a terrestrial, tropical [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Kooriva system/Legends|Kooriva system]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. The adopted homeworld of the [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar]] species, the planet was purchased by the horned-[[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] after a lengthy legal battle with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. While the planet suffered an economic crisis under the reign of the [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentric]]-biases of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Kooriva recovered and thrived under both [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] rule.

==History==
[[File:Koorivar_NEGAS.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar]] merchant.]]
A tropical planet first ruled by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] circa [[30,000 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the planet was eventually recolonized by a homeless species of horned-[[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] who eventually took up the name [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar]]. While the Koorivar were able to maintain a hold on the planet for several millennia, the planet's indigenous population, with the help of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]], ousted the Koorivar, forcing them to wander the stars for several hundred years. Despite these efforts, the Koorivar persevered and won enough support to buy the planet and gain representation in the Senate. Once the Koorivar had returned, the economy on the planet flourished and the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] grew a strong foothold on the world.<ref name="UAA" />

The planet became involved in galactic-wide politics when its [[Senator/Legends|senator]], [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], became an unwitting pawn of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. Argente, the [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] of the Corporate Alliance, led the planet away from the Republic and took a seat on the governing [[Separatist Council/Legends|Council]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], a [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|separatist group]] which would engage in all out war with the Republic. As the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the [[Twentieth Army|20th Sector Army]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] patrolled the area of space surrounding Kooriva.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> As the war raged, the planet eventually [[Campaign on Kooriva|fell]] to the Republic through the efforts of [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]].<ref name="DB-Cody, Clone Commander">{{DB|character|commandercody|Cody, Clone Commander}}</ref> In the wake of the war and the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Kooriva suffered an economic depression as the Empire punished the planet for its involvement with the Confederacy. Despite this setback, the world flourished under both the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. The [[Galactic Alliance Committee on Corporate Oversight]] regarded the Koorivar with suspicion and kept a wary eye on them.<ref name="NEGAS" /> Having avoided the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Kooriva was eventually engulfed by the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]] of [[Darth Krayt]].<ref name="TEA" />
